prompt: A workflow should publish a human-readable report — tables, lists, rendered markdown — right on the run page. Which mechanism does that?
explanation: Whatever a step appends to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` renders as markdown on the run page under the job — the built-in home for test tables and release notes. Logs and artifacts hold the same text, but nothing renders them as a report.

options.text: Echo markdown into the job log between `::group::` markers
Append markdown to the `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` environment file
Upload a `summary.md` artifact next to the build outputs
Have the workflow open a pull request that carries the report
